newsitem.title: ITALY: U.N. to launch emergency appeal on Zaire crisis.
newsitem.headline: U.N. to launch emergency appeal on Zaire crisis.

text.p: The United Nations is planning an emergency appeal to world nations for millions of dollars to help with the crisis in eastern Zaire, Rwanda and Burundi, a senior U.N. official said on Friday.
Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali will launch the appeal on Monday for aid needed over the next three months, Marcello La Stella told reporters at the U.N.-sponsored World Food Summit in Rome.

La Stella, who deals with special relief operations for the U.N.'s Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), said the "flash appeal" would go to U.N. members through various agencies, including the Geneva-based High Commissioner for Refugees.

The appeal would cover "immediate humanitarian needs", he said. For its part, FAO was seeking $4.9 million for bean and vegetable seeds as well as agricultural tools that would be used in Zaire, Rwanda and Burundi.
Western powers are putting together a multinational force for eastern Zaire that would allow aid to be delivered to starving refugees in the region.
